# Retrieval fixtures

Four pages from [ViDoRe v3](https://huggingface.co/datasets/vidore/vidore_v3_finance_en), with queries and relevance judgments from the same dataset (CC BY 4.0). The pages come from public-domain documents, re-encoded as JPEG since that's how the worker reads pages.

| Page | Source |
|---|---|
| `stock-performance.jpg` | Citigroup 2024 Form 10-K, page 317, from [SEC EDGAR](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000831001/000083100125000067/0000831001-25-000067-index.html) |
| `adverse-event-reports.jpg` | CDER Office of Surveillance and Epidemiology 2018 update, from [FDA](https://www.fda.gov/about-fda/center-drug-evaluation-and-research-cder/meeting-presentations-drugs) |
| `generic-applications.jpg` | AAM GRx+Biosims September 2018 presentation, from [FDA](https://www.fda.gov/about-fda/center-drug-evaluation-and-research-cder/meeting-presentations-drugs) |
| `jack-maintenance.jpg` | USAF Technical Order 32-1-101, from [Robins AFB](https://www.robins.af.mil/Portals/59/6%20June_TO%2032-1-101.pdf), approved for public release |
